name: of1-recommendation-quiz-match
description: A 'matched to you' quiz-result layout: a top match with a match-strength meter and why-it-fits list, a recap of the visitor's answers, and close runner-up cards with match scores.

slots.instruction: Short kicker signaling the result of a personalization quiz, e.g. 'Your match is in'.
Headline announcing the matched product based on the visitor's answers.
One-sentence explanation that the pick was matched against what the visitor told us.
Primary hero call to action jumping to the match result.
Product image for the top match. Use a real Xfinity asset URL.
Badge label flagging this as the visitor's top match.
Name of the matched product.
Monthly price of the matched product.
Short pricing reassurance such as contract or price-guarantee terms.
Match strength label shown with the meter, e.g. '94% match'.
Paragraph explaining why this product is the strongest match for the visitor's answers.
List of point-by-point reasons the match fits, each tying back to a stated need.
Call to action to choose the matched product.
Heading introducing the recap of the visitor's quiz answers, e.g. 'Based on what you told us'.
List recapping the answers or preferences the visitor gave that drove the match.
Heading introducing the close runner-up options.
Product image for the first runner-up card. Use a real Xfinity asset URL matching the product.
Name of the first runner-up product.
Match strength for the first runner-up, e.g. '86% match'.
Monthly price of the first runner-up.
Short description of the first runner-up and how it compares to the match.
Link to view or select the first runner-up.
Product image for the second runner-up card. Use a real Xfinity asset URL matching the product.
Name of the second runner-up product.
Match strength for the second runner-up, e.g. '78% match'.
Monthly price of the second runner-up.
Short description of the second runner-up and how it compares to the match.
Link to view or select the second runner-up.
Product image for the third runner-up card. Use a real Xfinity asset URL matching the product.
Name of the third runner-up product.
Match strength or label for the third runner-up, e.g. 'Great add-on'.
Monthly price of the third runner-up.
Short description of the third runner-up and how it compares to the match.
Link to view or select the third runner-up.
Closing call-to-action heading.
Closing call-to-action supporting copy.
Final call to action to start the order.

label: Recommendation - Quiz Match
